parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) When alcohols react with carboxylic acids, esters are produced.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Ester Y has the following composition by mass: C, 58.82%; H, 9.80%; O, 31.37%. Calculate the empirical formula of ester Y . empirical formula = .............................. [3]

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Ester Z has the empirical formula C 3 H 6 O and a relative molecular mass of 116. Calculate the molecular formula of ester Z . molecular formula = .............................. [1]
